description: List schedules oldest reference first with client, currency and counts as at a date: late, still owed, accepted. Filter by client, reference and state open or complete. Free.

as_of.description: Read the schedule as at this date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today

client.description: Only schedules whose client name contains this text

limit.description: Maximum schedules returned, default and ceiling 500

reference.description: Only the schedule against this quote, work order or change order

state.description: open for a job with a deliverable that is not yet accepted, complete for one where every deliverable is

name: delivery_schedule_list
title: List delivery schedules
